scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Bucket: a portion of capital with a job and a cap. Risk register: a scored list of risks and responses. Kill rule: a pre-written exit trigger. Benchmark: the simple alternative you must beat. time-weighted return: return that ignores deposit timing.
scenes.cap: Bucket: a portion of capital with a job and a cap. Risk register: a scored list of risks and responses. Kill rule: a pre-written exit trigger. Benchmark: the simple alternative you must beat. TWR: return that ignores deposit timing.

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner: Has buckets, caps and a journal. Practitioner: Keeps a scored risk register, uses the strategy library, measures time-weighted return versus a benchmark. Master: Runs a disciplined routine with written rules for behaviour, reviewed monthly.
